meta_description:
492K likes, 3,903 comments - beautifuldestinations on February 13, 2026: "Chunda Valley in Skardu is one of the most peaceful places in northern Pakistan.

Tucked away in Gilgit-Baltistan, this hidden valley is known for its bright green meadows, glacier-fed streams and views of the Karakoram mountains. Just a short drive from Skardu town, it’s a favourite for travellers exploring northern Pakistan, Hunza and the wider Gilgit-Baltistan region.

Best time to visit: May to September for lush green landscapes, mild temperatures and clear mountain views. Spring and early summer bring wildflowers and flowing streams, while autumn offers golden tones and crisp air. Winters are beautiful but can be harsh, with snow and limited access.

If you’re planning a Pakistan travel itinerary, looking for quiet places in Skardu or searching for scenic valleys in northern Pakistan, Chunda Valley is one to add to your list.

📽️ @emtiaazhussain_
📍Chunda Valley, Skardu, Gilgit-Baltistan, Pakistan".
